build_roi_heads: build ROI heads combining box, mask, and keypoint heads from a config and input channels
create_CombinedROIHeads: create a CombinedROIHeads module that combines box, mask, and keypoint heads into a single module
run_CombinedROIHeads_forward: run the CombinedROIHeads forward pass on features and proposals to get detections and losses
review_CombinedROIHeads_init: review the CombinedROIHeads constructor to understand how feature extractors are shared between heads
refactor_build_roi_heads: refactor build_roi_heads to conditionally include box, mask, or keypoint heads based on config flags
